Subject: Redemption cadence proposal — AuroraAI private-offer (GCP marketplace)

Hi Alexandra / Liam,

Thanks again for the time last week — really excited to get AuroraAI onto the marketplace private-offer. Per our call, attaching a short proposal for a redemption cadence that balances Aurora's go-to-market cadence with predictable billing for Marketplace. High level: 

- Two candidate tracks (we think one will fit):
  1) Staggered monthly redemption (recommended) — spreads commit over 6 months to smooth burn and reduce refund risk.
  2) Frontloaded redemption — larger initial drawdown with smaller trailing months (good if you need headroom now).

Key asks from your side to finalize:
- Confirm invoice billing entity (legal name + billing email).
- Who will sign the private-offer PO in DocuSign?
- Any constraints from GCP co-sell (e.g., reseller-crediting or multi-subsidiary split)?

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Tuesday or Wednesday to lock dates and confirm DocuSign recipients. I can circulate an updated MAP (mutual action plan) after that.

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

P.S. I'll draft a month-by-month example if you confirm billing entity — that will make the drawdown triggers explicit.

Logan — thanks for the outline. A couple quick clarifying items before we sync: 

1) Billing: invoices should go to AuroraAI, Inc. — billing@aurora.ai (we have two subsidiaries but AuroraAI, Inc. will own the commitment).
2) DocuSign: please set the signatory to Elena Park (elena.park@aurora.ai) — she handles marketplace POs.
3) Co-sell: our GTM lead wants to ensure we keep at least 25% of the commit available for co-sell enablement discounts through Q4. Is there flexibility in the staggered plan to reserve a bucket?

If you can include a draft schedule with a reserved co-sell bucket we can move faster. Tuesday afternoon works for a sync for Elena to join.

Alexandra — thanks, great context. Attached are two artefacts: a draft redemption spreadsheet (aurora-redemption-draft.xlsx) and a 1-page MAP summary (aurora-map_summary.pdf). I also created a placeholder DocuSign envelope with Elena as signatory (link below).

Summary of the recommended staggered plan (version A, preserves 25% co-sell bucket):
- Total commitment: 2,000,000 units (example).
- Reserved co-sell bucket: 500,000 units (25%) held in reserve for co-sell activations through Q4.
- Redemption schedule for remaining 1,500,000 units: monthly triggers over 6 months: 350k / 300k / 250k / 200k / 200k / 200k.
- Invoice triggers: invoice generated at each redemption milestone; final true-up at month 7 if bucket unused.

Notes for Marketplace ops: 
- We can set the private-offer to allow reserve-release on co-sell signatures (Redwood can manually release bucket upon marketplace credit confirmation).
- If Aurora needs split invoicing across subsidiaries we can accommodate with an invoice routing exception; please confirm legal tax entity details if so.

Links & attachments: 
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/23984
- DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC123XYZ
- Attachments: aurora-redemption-draft.xlsx, aurora-map_summary.pdf

If that looks good I will: (a) update the private-offer fields, (b) send DocuSign to Elena, and (c) schedule the Tuesday sync with Elena and your GTM lead.

Logan
